source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: At the opening of either [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), you may move one [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker of yours up to 6″. Both the marker and this model must already be on the battlefield. The marker must have stayed put so far this turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
